scope: User-supplied nine-card one-drop comparison, not expanded metagame search or playtesting

cards.name: Lightstall Inquisitor
cards.assessment: Independent vigilant body, but opponent chooses the card and retains access; taxes only that exiled card, not the entire hand. Not discard or a universal spell tax.

source_record.name: Lightstall Inquisitor
source_record.oracle_text:
Vigilance
When this creature enters, each opponent exiles a card from their hand and may play that card for as long as it remains exiled. Each spell cast this way costs {1} more to cast. Each land played this way enters tapped.
source_record.flavor_text: Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.

cards.name: Ambitious Augmenter
cards.assessment: Lead resilience option: increment grows through normal spell deployment; counter-bearing death leaves a Fractal; Smile returns the original with counters. Exile bypasses death payoff; large growth eventually disables incremental growth but other engines remain.

source_record.name: Ambitious Augmenter
source_record.oracle_text:
Increment (Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana you spent is greater than this creature's power or toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)
When this creature dies, if it had one or more counters on it, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token, then put this creature's counters on that token.

cards.name: Radioactive Spider
cards.assessment: Defensive reach/deathtouch plus optional Miles tutor. Real flexibility but sorcery-speed sacrifice and two mana reduce pressure; current reserved one-drop job prioritizes attacking.

source_record.name: Radioactive Spider
source_record.oracle_text:
Reach, deathtouch
Fateful Bite — {2}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a Spider Hero card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
source_record.flavor_text:
"Ow! A spider! It bit me! But why is it glowing that way?"
—Peter Parker

cards.name: Spinneret and Spiderling
cards.assessment: Interesting resource alternative: counter engines can enable four-damage trigger even without two-Spider attack trigger. Blocking/creature damage also qualifies. Legendary, no evasion; limited Spider density makes own growth less reliable.

source_record.name: Spinneret and Spiderling
source_record.oracle_text:
Whenever you attack with two or more Spiders, put a +1/+1 counter on Spinneret and Spiderling.
Whenever Spinneret and Spiderling deals 4 or more damage, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.

cards.name: Pawpatch Recruit
cards.assessment: Lead pressure option: trample converts counters to player damage; targeting your creatures grows another body; offspring adds optional bodies when cast but cannot be paid on Smile returns.

source_record.name: Pawpatch Recruit
source_record.oracle_text:
Offspring {2} (You may pay an additional {2} as you cast this spell. If you do, when this creature enters, create a 1/1 token copy of it.)
Trample
Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control other than that creature.

cards.name: Cenote Scout
cards.assessment: Strong consistency alternative: explore either supplies a land or counter plus selection/optional graveyard setup. Repeatable ETB on Smile; no evasion.

source_record.name: Cenote Scout
source_record.oracle_text: When this creature enters, it explores. (Reveal the top card of your library. Put that card into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then put the card back or put it into your graveyard.)
source_record.flavor_text: "If you're afraid to dive into the unknown, how will you ever find anything new?"

cards.name: Edge Rover
cards.assessment: Good base stats but symmetrical Lander death benefit helps opponent and costs mana to use. Less attractive than asymmetric pressure/resilience.

source_record.name: Edge Rover
source_record.oracle_text:
Reach
When this creature dies, each player creates a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
source_record.flavor_text: Charting the Edge, one scan at a time.

cards.name: Hemosymbic Mite
cards.assessment: Combat amplifier for Lightning/Academic, but weak alone. Attack-tap trigger happens after Ouroboroid beginning-of-combat trigger, not before. Temporary stats, not counters.

source_record.name: Hemosymbic Mite
source_record.oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, another target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.
source_record.flavor_text: By stimulating violent behavior in its host, the mite scavenges the remains of prey much too large for it to hunt on its own.

cards.name: Virulent Emissary
cards.assessment: Deathtouch and incidental life support defense but limited pressure and no resource replenishment; keep as matchup alternative.

source_record.name: Virulent Emissary
source_record.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.
source_record.flavor_text: "I could use a knife, but I'd miss that tremble under my fingers as the poison takes hold."
